cells.gaps: No evidence row is held on local government revenue records. What is held instead is two central systems: the DGI's micro-enterprise registration and payment software, whose tax is passed back to the collectivités territoriales, and the tax-administration chain run by the State's deconcentrated tax and treasury services. Whether any collectivité keeps its own digital revenue record is not established.
cells.note: No row on the sub-indicator, so no rung can be set. The central systems are noted and place nothing.
